name: booli-mcp
description: Booli.se real estate tools for Claude — search listings, sold prices, areas, and market stats

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Optional. Selects the path: auto (default — direct fetch first, browser-bridge fallback when walled), fetchproxy (always the bridge), or direct.

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Optional. The fetchproxy fleet shares WS port 37149; leave blank to use it.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface for the bridge, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank.

tools.name: booli_search_areas
tools.description: Resolve a place name to Booli area ids

tools.name: booli_search_listings
tools.description: Search active for-sale listings by area and filters

tools.name: booli_get_listing
tools.description: Full detail for one property (active or sold) by residence id

tools.name: booli_search_sold
tools.description: Search sold listings (slutpriser) with final prices

tools.name: booli_market_stats
tools.description: Median/average sold-price statistics for an area

tools.name: booli_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the Booli data path (direct or via the browser bridge)
